plugins.name: extract-business-rules
plugins.description: Extract a feature's business rules from code, confirm them with a human one rule at a time, and record them as numbered guardrails for refactors and migrations.

plugins.name: guard-business-rules
plugins.description: Install a PreToolUse hook that asks a human before Claude changes, deletes or moves a unit test or source line that protects an active BR-<FEATURE>-<NNN> business rule.
